text:
# Pre-market brief, Thu 2026-11-12 (as of ~8:20 AM ET)

1. **NVDA CEO shock (high impact).** WSJ reported the board is preparing to remove CEO Jensen Huang after reports of a second affair (one allegedly with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset); Bloomberg says Nvidia hired an outside firm to find a successor. No confirmed board decision yet. NVDA −5.6% to −7.7% pre ([Reuters via Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/nasdaq-futures-fall-as-nvidia-turmoil-rattles-ai-stocks-5020761); [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-nvidia-sinks-lilly-gains-on-china-approval-5021050)). Spillover: INTC, MRVL, MU −2.7% to −3.5%, CRWV ~−7% (Reuters). AMD +2.8% on William Blair upgrade; AVGO higher ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/stocks-moving-the-most-today-live-updates.html)).
2. **Futures (7:03 AM ET):** S&P E-minis −0.4%, Nasdaq-100 −0.86%, Dow +0.03% (Reuters).
3. **Rates/oil/BTC:** 10-yr 5.01% (+2bp), 2-yr 4.78% (+5bp) as bonds reopen; WTI $86.59, Brent $92.92 ~flat ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/us-treasurys-bonds-yields.html)). BTC ~$73,440, ETF outflows continue ([Saxo](https://www.home.saxo/en-gb/content/articles/macro/market-quick-take---nvidia-stumble-weighs-on-sentiment---12-november-2026-12112026)).
4. **Movers:** NBIS Q3 rev $980.8M vs $918.5M est., adj EBITDA $465.8M; +3% pre ([TokenPost](https://www.tokenpost.com/news/business/55374)). CTVA −8 to −10%: Q3 sales $1.59B miss, FY adj EPS guide cut to $0.76–0.80 vs $1.07 est. ([Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/markets/earnings/26/11/63174445/corteva-ceo-says-brazil-was-materially-weaker-than-anticipated)). YETI −8.9% on guide cut; MSTR −6% on MSCI deletion (after 11/30 close) ([StockTitan](https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/stock-market-today-live-november-12-2026)). LLY +2.8% on China approval of orforglipron (Investing.com). TTEK ~+10% on FQ4 beat (CNBC).
5. **Data/Fed today:** claims 8:30 (est. 195K vs 189K), existing home sales 10:00, 30-yr auction 1:00 PM; Fed speakers Hammack, Barr, Goolsbee, Daly, Schmid, Williams. PPI Fri (est. +0.4% m/m) ([Supercycle](https://www.supercycletrader.com/p/the-dollar-sets-another-high-as-gold-slips-back-under-4-000); Saxo). AMAT, CSCO after close.
6. **Earnings ≤10 days:** NVDA 11/17 AMC, HD 11/17 BMO, DIS 11/17 BMO, TJX/LOW/TGT 11/18 BMO, PANW 11/18 AMC, WMT 11/19 BMO, INTU 11/19 AMC ([TheStreet](https://pro.thestreet.com/earnings/week/2026-11-16)).

**Signals:** AI-hardware/data-center group avoid extended to 11/18 (NVDA leadership + earnings 11/17). New avoids: CTVA, YETI, MSTR.

**Swing ideas (long-only):**
- **LLY** — China approval for oral GLP-1 orforglipron, edge over Novo; +2.8% pre (<5%, no gap rule). Confidence low. Risk: pricing in China; rates at 5% hit multiples.
- (Watch, not logged) TTEK: >5% gap — log at close only if it holds.
